name: rambles-web
description: Rambles PWA — deployable static build. Edit main.jsx / app.jsx / data.js, then npm run build to regenerate app.js.

scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:ui
scripts.serve: node -e "const h=require('http'),f=require('fs'),p=require('path');const d=p.join(process.cwd(),'dist');const t={'.html':'text/html','.js':'text/javascript','.json':'application/json','.webmanifest':'application/manifest+json','.png':'image/png'};h.createServer((q,s)=>{let u=q.url.split('?')[0];if(u==='/')u='/index.html';const fp=p.join(d,u);f.readFile(fp,(e,b)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404);return s.end('not found')}s.writeHead(200,{'content-type':t[p.extname(fp)]||'application/octet-stream','cache-control':'no-cache'});s.end(b)})}).listen(8000,()=>console.log('serving web/dist on http://localhost:8000'))"
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run test:device && npm run audit:images
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run dist
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run dist
